subject: R1 favors H1.
contract_question: Under the stated conditions, does the transferred mechanism license the claimed relation between each hypothetical outcome and its stated evidential or operational consequence, without assuming that the outcome has actually occurred?

claim_context.value: If H1 and H2 remain unresolved, measure R next; R1 favors H1 and R2 favors H2.

evidence_bundle.text: The unresolved export fault is either encoder omission (H1) or transport loss (H2), with equal prior odds. R is a calibrated per-request encoder-output trace compared with the final received inventory under fixed workload. R1 means the missing item never appears in that trace; R2 means it appears there but not in the final inventory. Trace completeness has been independently verified.

For this calibrated trace under fixed workload, P(R1|H1)=0.9 and P(R1|H2)=0.1; P(R2|H1)=0.1 and P(R2|H2)=0.9. Record one next trace using the verified logger without altering either path. These likelihoods license directional updating, not certainty.
The team proposes a single next measurement and gives its subordinate anticipated discrimination logic. No R outcome has yet been observed.
